about_the_game:
Graduation Crisis – At This Fantamon Academy, Your Major Is Farming, But Your Final Thesis Is... Survival!

Genre: 2D Pixel | Farming Sim | RPG | Light Combat | Whimsical & Casual

The Gist:
You, the chosen one (or rather, the chosen unlucky one) of the Agriculture Department, dream of a simple life: graduate by farming. Instead, you're put in charge of a magical farm that attracts wild Fantamon for nightly raves. From then on, farming, fighting, sarcastic remarks, and dealing with a cast of eccentric NPCs become your new normal.

Game Description:
Welcome to the Fantamon Battle Academy! Here, everyone wants to be the top trainer—except for you. You just want a peaceful life of watering crops and watching them grow.

But fate has other plans. You're assigned to the academy's most "magical" plot: a farm legendary for growing crops that irresistibly attract wild Fantamon. Now, every harvest is accompanied by a Fantamon stampede. Can't fight? No problem! A series of "reliable" partners and quests—from the fisherman who never admits defeat to the bankrupt security guard obsessed with gacha games, and the suspicious farm manager Old Jin who seems to be hiding something—will "help" you rapidly become a... reluctantly recruited guardian of the greenery.

Farming, But More Than Farming:

  • Cultivate the Magical Plot: Start with four patches of荒地 and expand your farm. But beware: every Carrot or Advanced Corn you plant could be an invitation for a "Fantamon block party."

  • Befriend Whimsical Creatures: Collect and raise over 70 fantastical Fantamon with wild designs! From the Pricklehog with a cabbage on its head to the Sparkfruit containing a mini-storm, each comes with its own unique (and highly questionable) lore.

  • "Enjoy" Campus Life: Help idol trainees gather supplies for a concert, hunt down extreme ingredients for the hot-tempered master chef, offer expensive tributes to the fortune teller for cryptic advice, and face off against a battle-major rival who insists you're their destined opponent.

  • A Perilous Path to Graduation: Your road to graduation is littered with obstacles (sometimes literally, like the Gluttonous Thorns). Will you graduate on time, or be held back for remedial farming? It all depends on whether you can uncover the land's ultimate secret.

Key Features:

  • Farming Full of Surprises: Plant → Harvest → Get swarmed by Fantamon → Fight/Shoo them away → Collect loot → Repeat. It's the farming cycle, reinvented!

  • Deeply Immersive "24/7" Gameplay: Farm by day, run errands for neighbors, mine, fish, and settle disputes by night... whatever happened to being a casual farmer?

  • A Cast of Unforgettable NPCs: Every character is packed with hilarious dialogue and their own questlines, building a world brimming with absurd humor.

  • Extensive Crafting & Collection: From a simple Stone Hoe to the legendary Thunderflame Salad, from basic Wood to mysterious Source Essences, countless recipes and items await discovery.

  • Easy to Learn, Satisfying to Master: A streamlined Fantamon battle system that's easy to pick up but requires thoughtful strategy regarding type matchups and skills to handle sudden threats.

Coming Soon:
Graduation Crisis is concluding its closed beta at the "Fantamon Battle Academy" and coming to Steam! Wishlist the game now to get notified on launch day and receive special bonuses! Help this botanist with a green thumb (and a strong desire for peace) survive their Graduation Crisis!

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP or above
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: It's a pixel game with little performance requirements. I think it can run on 99% of players' computer who is reading the page
